nodes.name: Preprocessing of iron foam
nodes.procedure: Iron foam (FF) was preprocessed into dimensions of 1 × 2 cm² and cleaned with acetone, hydrochloric acid (0.1 M), and ultrapure water via ultrasonic treatment (10 min each step) to remove the surface oxides and adsorbed organic molecules.

nodes.name: One-step oxygen corrosion synthesis
nodes.procedure: The Pt-Co/Fe LDH catalyst was synthesized via a one-step oxygen corrosion method at room temperature. First, the cleaned FF was immersed in a mixture of 2M NaCl, 50mM CoCl₂·6H₂O, and 0.10mM H₂PtCl₆·H₂O and kept under shaking at room temperature for 15h. The resulting brown-black product was washed copiously with deionized water and dried at 60°C for 8h.

unit_operations.name: Immersion corrosion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: immersed in a mixture of 2M NaCl, 50mM CoCl₂·6H₂O, and 0.10mM H₂PtCl₆·H₂O and kept under shaking at room temperature for 15h

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM confirms flower-like interconnected nanosheets forming highly porous surface morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM image in Figure 2d further confirmed typical flower-like interconnected nanosheets on the Fe foam surface, forming a highly porous surface morphology.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals lattice fringe spacings of 0.25 nm and 0.33 nm corresponding to (012) and (021) planes of Co/Fe LDH and FeO(OH), respectively, and 0.221 nm for Pt (110) plane, indicating hierarchical heterojunction Co/Fe LDH@FeO(OH).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM image in Figure 2e revealed lattice fringe spacings of 0.25 and 0.33 nm corresponding to the (012) and (021) crystal planes of Co/Fe LDH... and a distinctive lattice fringe of 0.221 nm... ascribed to the (110) plane of Pt.

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD shows weak peaks at 11.1° (003), 22.6° (006), 33.6° (012), 41.9° (018), 59.0° (110), and 60.9° (113) indexed to Co/Fe LDH structure (PDF-50-0235), and FeO(OH) peaks confirming successful LDH fabrication.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The weak peaks at 11.1° (003), 22.6° (006), 33.6° (012), 41.9° (018), 59.0° (110), and 60.9° (113)... are indexed to the typical Co/Fe LDH structure; in addition, the FeO(OH) peaks... are seen in both Co/Fe LDH and Pt-Co/Fe LDH samples.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS confirms presence of Co, Fe, O, Pt elements; Pt 4f peaks at 74.1 and 70.7 eV indicate metallic Pt^0; Co 2p spin-orbit splitting ~16 eV with Co(II) at 781.9/797.3 eV and Co(III) at 780.4/795.9 eV; Fe 2p shows Fe^{3+} at 713.0/724.5 eV and Fe^{2+} at 710.7/726.9 eV; O 1s peaks at 529.7 eV (M-O), 531.2 eV (oxygen vacancies), 532.6 eV (hydroxyl/surface oxygen); Pt-Co/Fe LDH shows higher oxygen vacancy contribution than Co/Fe LDH.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-resolution XPS plot of Pt 4f in Figure 3c consists of two typical characteristic peaks at 74.1 and 70.7 eV assigned... to Pt 4f_{5/2} and Pt 4f_{7/2}, demonstrating... metallic Pt... the Co 2p_{1/2}-2p_{3/2} spin-orbit level energy spacing... about 16 eV, inferring... Co^{2+}... The Fe 2p plots... infer... Fe^{3+} (713.0 eV) and Fe^{2+} (710.7 eV)... the O 1s spectrum could be deconvoluted into O1... at 529.7 eV... O2... at 531.2 eV... oxygen vacancy sites... Pt-Co/Fe LDH possessed higher O2 and lower O1 contributions than Co/Fe LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical double-layer capacitance C_dl = 39.8 mF cm^{-2} for Pt-Co/Fe LDH, indicating higher ECSA than other catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Pt-Co/Fe displayed a C_dl value of 39.8 mF cm^{-2} higher than the other prepared catalysts, as revealed from the CV curves in Figures 5e and S15.
